usedFor: Retime takes the bookings, and HubSpot holds the deals. When “New Event Booked” fires in Retime, “Create Deal” in HubSpot can start a deal for the guest who booked.

bestTemplate.name: “New Event Booked” in Retime, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A booked meeting is a real sign of interest, and “Create Deal” puts it in the pipeline. “Update Deal” needs a deal that already exists, which a first booking will not have.

watchOut: “New Event Booked” is polling and looks at events in the next 30 days, so a booking made for a date further out is not picked up until it falls inside that window.
